title: The 10 Best Smart Water Shutoff Valves
subtitle: Automatic main water shutoffs and valve robots, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: We pulled the smart water shutoff valves selling on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: leak sensors in the box, flow monitoring, and DIY installation. Some kits use their own long-range radio to a Wi-Fi hub; the table shows which.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: YoLink X3 + EVO valve kit (4 sensors + hub)
awards.why: Valve robot, four leak sensors, and hub in one kit; sensors close the valve even with the internet down, rated 4.8 stars.

awards.label: Best Budget
awards.name: Tokatuker Wi-Fi valve actuator
awards.why: A $36.99 Wi-Fi valve robot that clamps onto an existing quarter-turn valve and works with Alexa and Google.

awards.label: Best Flow Monitor
awards.name: Frizzlife LP365
awards.why: Ultrasonic flow monitoring that spots leaks as small as 0.01 GPM and shuts the water off, rated 4.5 stars.

awards.label: Best for Matter
awards.name: EcoNet Bulldog Matter Wi-Fi (EVC400)
awards.why: A Bulldog valve robot on Matter over Wi-Fi with a wired leak sensor and no hub.

systems_note: YoLink, Moen Flo, and Tuya/Smart Life devices also have official Home Assistant integrations. YoLink kits use their own LoRa radio to a hub that connects to Wi-Fi.

buyers_guide.a: Not for valve robots and actuators, which clamp onto your existing quarter-turn main valve. Inline valves and whole-home flow monitors like Moen Flo are installed into the pipe and usually need a plumber.

buyers_guide.q: How does it know to shut off?
buyers_guide.a: Pair it with leak sensors, or pick a flow monitor that spots unusual water use. When a sensor gets wet, the valve closes the main line in seconds.

buyers_guide.q: Will it work with my valve?
buyers_guide.a: Robots fit most quarter-turn ball valves, but not gate valves with round handles. Check your main valve and pipe size before ordering.
